subject: Early payment discount offer
text:
Hi Larkspur AP,

Cobalt Freight is offering a 1.5 percent discount on invoices paid within 10 days of invoice date, starting with December invoices. If you'd like to take advantage, just pay within 10 days and deduct the discount; note it on the remittance. Payment goes to the same account as always.

Thanks,
Jasmine
